title: Item 15b · The line that tells staff what they can't change
subtitle: Approved in each section, plus drift. Pages staff can't change show a gray line. Most say “View only. Ask an admin to make changes.” (Color Belt, Star and Black Belt settings, Schedule). Calendar and Forms use a dash and a small “ask”, and Forms says “View only” although staff can fill in and share forms there. Pages staff can partly use already name what's left for an admin (Camps, Finance, the testing lists). Schedule's mockup drew the dash; its code already uses the full stop (drift). (Preview screenshots at PC size, signed in as staff · fake data)

items.caption: 1. Color Belt Classes and ranks (Star, Black Belt, Schedule the same): “View only. Ask an admin to make changes.”

row.caption: 2. Calendar: a dash and a small “ask”.
3. Forms: “View only” — but staff can fill in and share forms here.
4. Camps (staff run the roster): names what's left for an admin.
5. Finance (staff close today): the same idea, beside the day.

columns.label: Proposed (option B) · one pattern, two forms

items.caption: 6. Calendar: “View only. Ask an admin to make changes.” — the same words as most pages.
7. Forms: “Staff can fill in and share forms. Ask an admin to create or change forms.”

columns.note: The rule in B: where staff can only look — “View only. Ask an admin to [what only admins do].” Where staff can do part of the page — “[what staff can do]. Ask an admin to [the rest].” (as Camps, Finance and the testing lists already say). Full stops, a capital “Ask”, the same gray line. Pictures 6–7 are the real pages with their line reworded; nothing in the app was changed.

footer:
Your choice — one question:
A · Keep as today. + no work. − four wordings; Forms tells staff “View only” on a page where they can fill in and share.
B · Recommended: one pattern in two forms (pictures 6–7). “View only. Ask an admin to …” where staff can only look; “[what staff can do]. Ask an admin to …” where they can do part of it. Only Calendar's and Forms' lines change. + the line always means the same thing and never says “view only” where staff can act. − two small word changes (Calendar, Forms).
